description: Build a live countdown to your exam — name it, set the date, and track multiple exams saved in your browser.

faqs.a: Your exams are saved in this browser's localStorage, so they are still here when you come back. They don't sync between devices.
The biggest countdown at the top always shows your nearest upcoming exam. Past exams are marked as done.
faqs.q: Which exam shows the big countdown?

faqs.a: Yes — add as many as you like; each gets its own live days/hours/minutes/seconds countdown.

howto: Type the exam name and pick its date and time.
Press Add exam — a live countdown appears.
Your exams are saved automatically in this browser.
Delete an exam with the ✕ button when done.
title: Exam Countdown Maker
